title: Frame Study
author: Original UI demonstration text
provenance: Authored test fixture. All timestamps are deliberate test inputs, never Apple measurements or recovered musical timing.

lines.text: The next frame comes into view
A narrow column holds three measured rows
A second voice enters from the other side
The pause has its own space

testCases.name: phrase-granularity
testCases.check: The first span contains multiple words; do not split into uniform per-word durations.

testCases.name: timing-gap-within-line
testCases.check: No span is actively progressing between 1.35 and 1.55. The presentation policy is explicit, not a fabricated measured behavior.

testCases.name: potential-wrapping
testCases.check: Text wrapping is layout dependent. A semantic line can have multiple visual rows; maintain one timing identity.

testCases.name: split-token
testCases.check: The second portion of Movement is active; text concatenation must preserve the original word with no inserted space.

testCases.name: backing-vocals
testCases.check: Background and main vocals have independent span clocks.

testCases.name: overlap
testCases.check: Two lines are active. A single-active-index model must not erase the overlapping line.

testCases.name: inter-line-silence
testCases.check: No vocal span is active. The next-line focus/placeholder behavior is a labeled demo policy unless measured from reference.

testCases.name: seek-backward
testCases.check: Recompute all states from absolute media time without residual progress.
